transcript.content: Hi, I changed my password and now nothing works.
Okay, let me help. What's your name?
When did you change the password?
Wait, did you say you changed it or it was reset?
Actually, looking at the system, it says it was reset by an admin. Are you sure?
But the audit log shows an admin reset.
Oh, maybe IT reset it and told me to change it.
So it was an admin reset, not a self-service change?
I don't know, I just know I can't log in.
Okay no problem, let me check the account status.

ticket.summary: User James Wilson at Mercer & Tate Law cannot log in after password change/reset.
ticket.description: User initially said self-change, then admin reset. Account will be investigated.

expected.notes: Candidate handled contradictory information professionally. Score should be mid-range — not perfect but not failing. Engine has no specific contradiction handling so depends on evidence extraction quality.
